m: साप् strong form of 2. सप्, q.v.
सापाश्रय n. (scil. वास्तु) a house with an open gallery at the back, VarBṛS.
सापाय mf(आ)n. one who contends with adversity, Daśar.
attended with danger, dangerous, Kāv.; Pañcat.; Rājat.
सापीड mfn. (Perhaps w.r. for सोत्पीड.) emitting or discharging a stream of water, R.
सापद् mfn. being in distress or misery, Pañcat.
सापदेशम् ind. under a pretext or pretence, Daś.
सापगम mfn. attended with or involving departures, Pañcat.
सापह्नव mf(आ)n. with dissimulation, dissembling, feigning, MBh.; Kathās.
dissembled, concealed, veiled, Sāh.
सापमान mfn. treated or attended with contempt, Bhartṛ. (v.l.)
सापमानम् ind. contemptuously, MW.
सापराध mf(आ)n. having faults, criminal, guilty, Kathās.; Rājat.
faulty, false, erroneous, VarBṛS., Sch.
सापरान्त mfn. together with the country of Aparānta, Kathās.
सापर mf(आ)n. together with the west, VarBṛS.
सापत्न mfn. (fr. स-पत्न, or सपत्नी) coming or derived from a rival, AV.
based on rivalry (as enmity), MBh.
born of a rival or co-wife
सापत्न m. (with or without भ्रातृ, ‘a half-brother on the mother's side’), R.
(pl.) the children of different wives of the same husband, MBh.
a: सापत्न — a. (नी f.) Born from or belonging to a rival wife. --त्नाः (m. pl.) The children of different wives of the same husband.

m: सापत्नक n. rivalry among the wives of the same husband, MBh.
rivalry in general, enmity, ib.; Bālar.
सापत्नेय mf(ई)n. born from a rival wife, Kull. en, Mn. ix, 198.

s: puM, (sapanta eva । svArTe zyaY) SatruH । ityamarawIkAyAM ramAnATaH । 2 । 8 । 10 ॥ (sapatnyA apatyamiti । sapantI + zyaY .) sapatnIputtraH । yaTA, bahaspatiH । “pitrA saha viBaktA ye sApatnyA vA sahodarAH jaGanyajASca ye tezAM pitfBAgaharAstu te ॥” iti dAyatattvam ॥ (sapatnyA BAvaH । sapantI + brAhmaRAditvAt vyaY .) sapatnIBAve, klI ॥ (yaTA, mAGe । 8 । 15 । “gityAyA nijavasaternirAsire yadrAgeRa SriyamaravindataH karAgrEH । vyaktavyaM niyatamanena ninyurasyAH sApatnyaM kzitisutavidvizo mahizyaH ॥”)
v: pu॰ sapatna eva svArTe zyaY । 1 SatrO amaraH । sapatnyAM BavaH tasyA apatyaM vA yaY । 1 sapatnIputre । aR । sApatno'pyuBayatra ।
m: सापत्न्य mf(आ)n. based on rivalry (as enmity), Kām.
born from a rival or fellow-wife, R.
सापत्न्य m. a half-brother, ib.
a rival, enemy, L.
सापत्न्य n. enmity or rivalry among wives of the same husband, Śiś.
relationship of children born from different wives of the same husband, R.
a: सापत्न्यं — 1 The state or condition of a rival wife. --2 Rivalry, ambition, enmity. --त्न्यः 1 The son of a rival wife. --2 An enemy.

m: सापत्न्यक n. rivalry, enmity, Bālar.
सापत्रप mf(आ)n. ashamed, embarrassed, Śiś.
1. सापत्य mf(आ)n. possessing offspring, having progeny, MBh.
accompanied or attended by one's children, BhP.
2. सापत्य m. = सापत्न्य, the son of a rival wife, half-brother, Pat. on Pāṇ. vi, 3, 35, Vārtt. 11.

a: सापवाद — a. 1 Spreading or indulging in scandal; U. 1. 6. --2 Attended with a scandal; U. 2. --दं ind. Censuringly.

m: सापवादक mfn. having exceptions, liable to exception, Pat.
सापवादम् ind. with blame, reproachfully, Mālatīm.
सापेक्ष mfn. having regard or respect to (loc. or acc. with प्रति), MBh.; R.
requiring or presupposing anything, dependent on (comp.), Kathās.; Sāh.; Sarvad.
a: सापेक्ष — a. Having regard to, dependent on, (usually in comp.).

m: सापेक्ष—ता f.
सापेक्ष—त्व n. dependence on Sāh.; Sarvad.

a: सापिंड्यं — Connection by the offering of rice-balls to the same Manes, kindred, consanguinity.

m: सापिण्डी-मञ्जरी f. N. of wk. on law by Nāgeśa.
सापिण्ड n. = सापिण्ड्य, Dattakac.
सापिण्डि m. (prob.) patr. fr. स-पिण्ड, g. ऐषुकार्य्-आदि.
सापिण्डि—भक्त mfn. inhabited by Sāpiṇḍis, ib.

s: klI, (sapiRqasya BAvaH । sapiRqa + zyaY .) sapiRqatAM । sA tu puM sAM saptamapuruzaparyyantaM anUQakanyAnAM tripuruzaparyyantaYca sTAyinI । yaTA, -- “lepaBAjaScaturTAdyAH pitrAdyAH piRqaBAginaH piRqadaH saptamastezAM sApiRqyaM sAptapOruzam iti matsyapurARam ॥ aprattAnAM tripOruzam । iti vaSizWaH ॥ api ca “pitrAdizaqBiH sApiRqyaM tattatsantatisaptakEH gotrEkye sati tattu syAt zaqBiH puttrAdiBistaTA । aprattAnAntu kanyAnAM triBiH pitrAdiBiH smftam ॥” iti kArikA ॥ anyat sapiRqaSabde drazwavyam ॥
v: na॰ sapiRqasya BAvaH zyaY । dAyASOcagrahaRAdyupayogini jYAtiDarmaBede “sApiRqyaM sAptapOruzami” ti smftiH । sapiRqaSabde 5 220 pf॰ dfSyam ।
m: सापिण्ड्य n. (fr. स-पिण्ड) connection or relationship by presenting offerings to the same deceased ancestors, consanguinity or relationship of a Sapiṇḍa, Saṃskārak.; Dattakac.
सापिण्ड्य—दीपिका f. N. of wk.
सापिण्ड्य—कल्पलता f. N. of wk.
सापिण्ड्य—कल्पलतिका f. N. of wk.
सापिण्ड्य—मीमांसा f. N. of wk.
सापिण्ड्य—निर्णय m. N. of wk.
सापिण्ड्य—विषय m. N. of wk.
साप्राय्य n. (fr. स-प्राय) likeness, homogeneousness, Lāṭy.
साप्सरो-गण mfn. attended by a number of Apsarases, MW.
1. साप्त or साप्त n. (fr. सप्तन्, of which it is also the Vṛddhi form in comp.) the number seven, a heptad, RV.; TS.
a team of seven horses (accord. to others m. and a proper N.), RV. viii, 55, 5.
2. साप्त n. (fr. सप्ति) a horse-race, running-match for horses or the prize given for one, RV. ii, 19, 7.
साप्त—दश्य n. (fr. सप्तदशन्) the number seventeen, ŚāṅkhŚr.
साप्तलायन m. patr. fr. सप्तल, g. नडादि.
साप्तलेय mfn. (fr. id.) g. सख्य्-आदि.
साप्तमिक mfn. (fr. सप्तमी) relating to the seventh day, Lāṭy.
relating to the seventh case, RPrāt.
taught in the seventh (Adhyāya of Pāṇini's grammar), Pat.

v: tri॰ sapta puruzAn vyApnoti aR uBayapadavfdDiH saptapuruzavyApake ।
m: साप्त—पौरुष mf(ई)n. (fr. id.) =, prec. Mn. iii, 146.
a: साप्तपौरुष — a. (षी f.) Extending to or including seven generations; Ms. 3. 146.

s: klI, (saptaBiH padEravApyate iti । “sAptapadInaM saKyam .” 5 । 2 । 22 । iti KaY pratyayena sADuH .) saKyam । ityamaraH । 2 । 8 । 12 ॥ (yaTA, kumAre । 5 । 39 । “prayuktasatkAraviSezamAtmanA na mAM paraM sampratipattumahasi । yataH satAM sannatagAtri ! saNgataM manIziBiH sAptapadInamucyate ॥”) saptapadasambanDini, tri ॥
v: na॰ saptaBiH padEH uccAritErnirvfttam KaY । saKye sOhArdde amaraH “sAptapadInaM saKyam” pA॰ ।
m: साप्त—पदीन mfn. = prec. Bālar.
साप्त—पदीन n. friendship (formed with any one after taking seven paces together, or accord. to others after uttering only seven words), intimacy, Kum.; Pañcat.
circumambulation of the nuptial fire by the bride and bridegroom in seven steps, advance of the bride to meet the bridegroom in seven steps, MW.,

k.v: वयस्यः स्निग्धः सवया अथ मित्रं सखा सुहृत्. सख्यं साप्तपदीनं स्यादनुरोधोऽनुवर्तनम्.।

m: साप्त—पद mfn. (fr. सप्त-पद) belonging to seven steps, based or depending on seven steps (= ‘sincere’, ‘true’), MBh.; Pañcat.; BrahmaP.
a: साप्तपद — a. (दी f.), साप्तपदीन a. [cf. P. V. 2. 22] Formed by walking together seven steps, or by talking together seven words; यतः सतां संनतगात्रि संगतं मनीषिभिः साप्तपदीनमुच्यते Ku. 5. 39 (where the latter sense appears better); Pt. 2. 43, 4. 103. --दं, --नं 1 Circumambulation of the nuptial fire by the bride and bridegroom in seven steps (which makes the marriage tie irrevocable). --2 Friendship, intimacy.

m: साप्त—पुरुष mfn. (fr. सप्त-प्˚) extending to or comprising seven generations, Saṃskārak.
साप्त—रात्रिक mf(ई)n. (fr. सप्त-रात्र) lasting seven nights or days, SāmavBr.; Hariv.
साप्त—रथ-वाहनि m. a patr. ŚBr.
साप्त—तन्तव m. pl. (fr. सप्त-तन्तु) N. of a partic. sect, Vās., Introd.
साप्ततिक mfn. (fr. सप्तति) worth seventy &c., Pāṇ. v, 1, 19, Sch.
साप्ति m. patr. fr. सप्तन्, g. बाह्व्-आदि.
साप्य m. patr. of Namī (v.l. साय्य), RV.; PañcavBr.
